content.text:
10. REMOVE NO. 3 TIMING BELT COVER
Remove the five bolts and remove the cover and gasket.

content.description: Idler pulley assembly showing tension relief mechanism with hand using screwdriver

items: (a) Loosen the idler pulley set bolt a little and shift the idler pulley to the alternator side with a screwdriver and wrench.
(b) Finger tighten the set bolt and then relieve the timing belt tension.

content.text: 12. REMOVE TIMING BELT FROM CAMSHAFT TIMING PULLEYS

content.description: Camshaft timing pulleys showing SST tool placement for pulley removal

content.text: Using SST to hold the pulley, remove the pulley set bolt, timing pulley, and match pin.
Do not make use of the timing belt tension when removing and installing the pulley set bolt.
The exhaust and intake sides each use a different type of pulley — they are not interchangeable.

content.description: Crankshaft pulley removal showing SST tool placement on both sides

items: (a) Using SST to hold the crankshaft pulley, loosen the pulley bolt.
(b) Remove the SST and pulley bolt.
